notes: PREBUFF/REBUFF is now explicitly temporary. Before buffing, the companion snapshots AUTO/FOLLOW/WEAPON state. After the queued buff-cast chain is no longer running, it clears PREBUFF/REBUFF/action locks and restores the prior mode; FOLLOW is actively reissued. A 40-second fail-safe also clears the queue and restores state, so successful buffing cannot leave Dorna permanently stuck in REBUFF. If a hostile appears during buffing, combat still overrides and switches to AUTO attack immediately. Preserves 0.8.6.6 party-bar buff anchoring and the confirmed Plada level-progression repair unchanged; protected combat core remains 0.7.10.7.
